version_facts.current_stable_date_note: endoflife.date lists 4.7.2 on 2026-08-16; godotengine.org/download shows '18 August 2026' (page shows the announcement date). Both checked 2026-09-15.
version_facts.branch_state: 4.7 branch version.py = 4.7.3 status rc; master = 4.8 dev (checked 2026-09-15)

regex_flags: python re, compile with re.MULTILINE; null = not statically detectable

rows.new: var d: Dictionary[String, int] = {}; both key and value type required (use Variant for either); nested typed collections not supported
rows.agent_rule: On 4.4+ type dictionaries as `Dictionary[K, V]`, never nest a typed collection inside the brackets, and never emit this syntax for a project pinned below 4.4.

rows.change: .uid sidecar files for scripts and shaders
rows.old: Only imported resources and scenes carried UIDs; scripts referenced by path
rows.new: Godot writes `<file>.gd.uid` / `<file>.gdshader.uid` next to the source; uid:// paths (e.g. preload("uid://...")) resolve through them
rows.agent_rule: When creating, moving, renaming or deleting a .gd/.gdshader file, create/move/rename/delete its .uid sidecar in the same operation, never hand-edit or duplicate a UID, and never gitignore *.uid.

rows.change: @export_file stores uid:// instead of res:// when set from the Inspector
rows.new: Values assigned in the Inspector are stored as uid:// (arrays may mix uid:// and res://); GH-97912
rows.agent_rule: Treat @export_file values as opaque loadable paths (pass to load()/ResourceLoader), never string-match `res://` on them, and use @export_file_path (4.5+) when a raw res:// path is genuinely needed.

rows.new: Same methods return bool (false on failure); GH-78289. GDScript-compatible, C# binary-incompatible
rows.agent_rule: After FileAccess.store_* calls in write paths, check the bool result or FileAccess.get_error() instead of assuming the write succeeded.

rows.new: OS.read_string_from_stdin(buffer_size: int); GH-91201; GDScript-incompatible
rows.agent_rule: Always pass an explicit buffer_size to OS.read_string_from_stdin().

rows.new: Adds optional `breadcrumb`, removes many previous parameters; GDScript-incompatible
rows.agent_rule: Do not copy pre-4.4 draw_list_begin() argument lists; use the 4.4+ signature from the class reference.

rows.new: new_rect: Rect2 (incompatible in all bindings)
rows.agent_rule: Type the frame_rect_changed handler parameter as Rect2.

rows.new: Range enforced; adjust min_value/max_value if points fall outside
rows.agent_rule: When adding Curve points outside 0..1, set min_value/max_value first.

rows.new: Non-manifold meshes unsupported (GH-94321); use MeshInstance3D for quads/planes
rows.agent_rule: Never build CSG from non-manifold geometry (planes, quads); use MeshInstance3D instead.

rows.change: Jolt Physics integrated into the engine (opt-in)
rows.old: Jolt only as a third-party extension
rows.new: Built-in, enabled via physics/3d/physics_engine project setting
rows.agent_rule: On 4.4/4.5 assume Godot Physics unless project.godot sets physics/3d/physics_engine to Jolt.

rows.new: @export_tool_button(text: String, icon: String = "") exports a Callable as a button in @tool scripts
rows.agent_rule: Use @export_tool_button only in @tool scripts and only for projects pinned to 4.4+.

rows.change: Android sensor events disabled by default
rows.new: Must be enabled under Input Devices > Sensors (GH-94799)
rows.agent_rule: If code reads Input.get_accelerometer()/gyroscope on Android, tell the user to enable the sensor project settings.

rows.old: No abstract support; runtime assert/push_error patterns
rows.new: @abstract on class or method; abstract method has no body (newline/semicolon after header); a class with any unimplemented abstract method must itself be @abstract
rows.agent_rule: Use @abstract only on 4.5+; give abstract methods no body and mark every class that leaves an abstract method unimplemented as @abstract.

rows.new: func f(a, b = 0, ...args): — at most one rest parameter, last, no default; typed Array not supported as the rest type; no spread syntax at call sites
rows.agent_rule: Declare at most one trailing `...args` parameter, never give it a default or a typed-array type, and never spread an array into a call (`f(...arr)` is invalid).

rows.change: Resource.duplicate(true) no longer duplicates external subresources
rows.old: duplicate(true) copied everything including external resources
rows.new: Only internal (path-less or scene-local) subresources are copied; use duplicate_deep(DEEP_DUPLICATE_ALL) for the old behavior (modes: NONE=0, INTERNAL=1, ALL=2)
rows.agent_rule: When a deep copy must include external .tres/.res subresources, call duplicate_deep(Resource.DEEP_DUPLICATE_ALL) instead of duplicate(true).

rows.old: No way to keep a raw res:// string with a file picker
rows.new: @export_file_path(filter, ...) stores the raw path (may break if the file moves)
rows.agent_rule: Use @export_file_path only when a raw res:// string is required and the project is 4.5+; otherwise prefer @export_file.

rows.old: add_image(image, width, height, color, inline_align, region, key, pad, tooltip, size_in_percent)
rows.new: size_in_percent replaced by width_in_percent + height_in_percent; alt_text added (GH-107347, GH-76829). Old positional size_in_percent now feeds width_in_percent and height defaults to false
rows.agent_rule: Pass width_in_percent and height_in_percent explicitly (both) when calling add_image/update_image with percentage sizing.

rows.new: node.get_node_rpc_config() (GH-106848); GDScript-incompatible
rows.agent_rule: Call get_node_rpc_config() on 4.5+.

rows.new: JSONRPC.set_method(...) (GH-104890)
rows.agent_rule: Use JSONRPC.set_method(); set_scope is a non-functional stub.

rows.new: Removed; GDScript-incompatible
rows.agent_rule: Do not call RenderingServer.instance_reset_physics_interpolation/instance_set_interpolated on 4.5+.

rows.change: TileMapLayer physics chunking on by default
rows.new: Chunked by physics_quadrant_size; set physics_quadrant_size = 1 to restore exact cells
rows.agent_rule: If code maps a body RID back to a cell, set TileMapLayer.physics_quadrant_size = 1 or expect quadrant-precision results.

rows.new: Setting removed (GH-105746); use layers/masks to ignore
rows.agent_rule: Never write the areas_detect_static_bodies setting; filter Area3D/static overlaps with collision layers and masks.

rows.change: Navigation regions update asynchronously by default
rows.new: Threaded; toggle navigation/world/region_use_async_iterations; merge_rasterizer_cell_scale may need lowering (min 0.01)
rows.agent_rule: Do not assume NavigationRegion changes are visible in the same frame; await NavigationServer map_changed or disable async iterations when determinism matters.

rows.new: Warning printed; use set_as_basic()/set_restart_if_changed()/set_as_internal()
rows.agent_rule: Pass only name/type/hint/hint_string to add_property_info and set usage flags through the dedicated ProjectSettings methods.

rows.old: Non-joint nodes in a skeleton hierarchy mis-handled
rows.new: Fixed for new .gltf/.glb/.blend/.fbx files; existing files keep old behavior unless the 'Naming Version' import option changes (GH-104184, GH-107352)
rows.agent_rule: Do not hard-code node paths under imported skeletons for newly imported models based on pre-4.5 hierarchies.

rows.new: Android needs net9.0 target (Google Play requirement); other platforms still .NET 8+
rows.agent_rule: For C# Android exports on 4.5+, target net9.0 in the .csproj.

rows.change: Jolt Physics is the default 3D physics engine for new projects
rows.new: New projects default to Jolt (GH-105737); existing projects keep their setting; physics/3d/physics_engine
rows.agent_rule: Read physics/3d/physics_engine from project.godot before relying on engine-specific 3D physics behavior; treat a 4.6+ project with no setting as Jolt.

rows.change: D3D12 default rendering driver on Windows for new projects
rows.new: D3D12 (GH-113213); rendering/rendering_device/driver.windows
rows.agent_rule: Do not assume Vulkan on Windows for 4.6+ projects; check rendering/rendering_device/driver.windows.

rows.change: load_steps no longer written; per-node unique_id saved
rows.old: [gd_scene load_steps=N format=3 uid=...] header; nodes tracked by name/parent only
rows.new: load_steps dropped (GH-103352, unused by the editor); each [node ...] gets a unique_id=<int> (GH-106837, fallback when a name lookup fails); files remain loadable in 4.5
rows.agent_rule: When hand-editing a .tscn on 4.6+, never add load_steps, never invent or copy a node's unique_id (omit it and let the editor assign one on re-save), and keep existing unique_id values untouched.

rows.new: StringName / Array[StringName] / StringName (GH-110767); GDScript-compatible, C# incompatible
rows.agent_rule: Type variables holding AnimationPlayer names as StringName (or Array[StringName] for get_queue()), not String/PackedStringArray.

rows.new: get_as_text()
rows.agent_rule: Call FileAccess.get_as_text() with no arguments.

rows.change: StreamPeerTCP/TCPServer methods moved to base classes
rows.new: disconnect_from_host/get_status/poll on StreamPeerSocket; is_connection_available/is_listening/stop on SocketServer (call sites unchanged)
rows.agent_rule: Nothing to change at call sites; do not write `is StreamPeerTCP` checks when a StreamPeerSocket would do.

rows.new: Removed
rows.agent_rule: Do not call EditorFileDialog.add_side_menu() in editor plugins targeting 4.6+.

rows.new: Screen (1), 0.3, 0.5; glow_levels reweighted; fog blending brighter
rows.agent_rule: When reproducing pre-4.6 looks, set Environment glow_blend_mode/glow_intensity/glow_levels explicitly instead of relying on defaults.

rows.change: AStar get_point_path/get_id_path return empty when the source is disabled/solid
rows.new: Empty array when the from-point is disabled (AStar2D/3D) or solid (AStarGrid2D)
rows.agent_rule: Check for an empty path result before indexing AStar path arrays.

rows.new: NodePath("") (compat via animation/compatibility/default_parent_skeleton_in_mesh_instance_3d)
rows.agent_rule: Set MeshInstance3D.skeleton explicitly when a mesh created in code must bind to a parent Skeleton3D.

rows.new: android/build/src/main/java/... (Android Studio layout)
rows.agent_rule: When editing Android build files, use the src/main/java path on 4.6+.

rows.change: Overrides of typed-return methods inherit the return type and need an explicit return
rows.old: An override without `->` could fall off the end (implicit null)
rows.new: Return type inherited from the parent (GH-115763); missing return is a parse error — add `return null` (or the value) at the end
rows.agent_rule: When overriding any engine or user method that declares a return type (e.g. _get_drag_data, _get, _property_can_revert, custom base methods), end every code path with an explicit return.

rows.change: Packed array element assignment no longer calls the property setter
rows.old: arr_prop[i] = x invoked the setter for the whole packed-array property
rows.new: Element assignment does not trigger the setter (GH-113228)
rows.agent_rule: If logic must run when a PackedXArray property changes, reassign the whole array (or call the setter) instead of relying on `prop[i] = x`.

rows.new: is_class(class: StringName) (GH-118582); GDScript-compatible (String literals still convert)
rows.agent_rule: Pass a StringName literal (&"Node2D") or String to is_class(); both work, prefer &"..." in hot paths.

rows.change: Mouse and keyboard device IDs are no longer 0
rows.new: InputEvent.DEVICE_ID_MOUSE = 32, DEVICE_ID_KEYBOARD = 16 (GH-116274); DEVICE_ID_EMULATION = -1 unchanged
rows.agent_rule: Never compare event.device to 0 to detect mouse/keyboard; check the event class or compare against InputEvent.DEVICE_ID_MOUSE / DEVICE_ID_KEYBOARD.

rows.old: No built-in way to pause a Tween sequence on a signal
rows.new: AwaitTweener tween_await(signal: Signal); AwaitTweener.set_timeout() when the signal may never fire (absent in 4.6 source)
rows.agent_rule: Use tween_await only for projects pinned to 4.7+; on older versions use tween_callback with a coroutine.

rows.new: width/height: float; width_unit/height_unit: RichTextLabel.ImageUnit (defaults 0); UPDATE_WIDTH_UNIT (GH-112617; the enum rename is GDScript-incompatible)
rows.agent_rule: On 4.7+ pass width_unit/height_unit (RichTextLabel.ImageUnit) and use ImageUpdateMask.UPDATE_WIDTH_UNIT; never use UPDATE_WIDTH_IN_PERCENT.

rows.new: Default 0 = disabled (GH-107679)
rows.agent_rule: If Area audio bus overrides must affect an AudioStreamPlayer, set its area_mask explicitly to the area layer.

rows.new: Removed (GH-114355)
rows.agent_rule: Do not read or write AudioEffectSpectrumAnalyzer.tap_back_pos.

rows.old: Jolt interpreted plane.d with the opposite sign to Godot Physics
rows.new: Same convention as Godot Physics (GH-118948); flip the sign to keep 4.6 Jolt behavior
rows.agent_rule: Use the Godot Physics sign convention for WorldBoundaryShape3D.plane.d under Jolt on 4.7+.

rows.change: SoftBody3D mass and linear_stiffness under Jolt
rows.old: Mass default 0 (1 kg per point); stiffness applied differently
rows.new: Mass default 1 kg total; linear_stiffness matches Godot Physics; Area3D now reports SoftBody3D overlaps (GH-116041, GH-114198)
rows.agent_rule: Re-tune SoftBody3D total_mass/linear_stiffness/damping_coefficient when targeting 4.7 Jolt and mask Area3D/SoftBody3D interactions explicitly.

rows.new: SyncMode enum sync_mode
rows.agent_rule: Set blend_space.sync_mode (enum) instead of a boolean sync.

rows.change: LinearToSRGB no clamp; CanvasItem line feather removed
rows.old: LinearToSRGB clamped to [0,1] on Mobile/Forward+; drawn lines had an antialiasing feather
rows.new: No clamp (GH-113956); no feather, lines appear thinner (GH-105122)
rows.agent_rule: Clamp manually in visual shaders if needed, and use a slightly larger width for draw_line() calls that relied on the old feather.

rows.change: New projects default to stretch mode canvas_items / aspect expand
rows.new: canvas_items / expand for newly created projects
rows.agent_rule: Read display/window/stretch/mode from project.godot instead of assuming `disabled`, and when a 4.7 project.godot omits it, treat it as canvas_items/expand.

rows.new: macOS 11
rows.agent_rule: Do not promise macOS 10.13–10.15 support for 4.7 builds.

rows.new: false
rows.agent_rule: Set LookAtModifier3D.relative explicitly when porting 4.6 setups.

rows.change: [UPCOMING] String literals used as comments trigger STANDALONE_EXPRESSION
rows.old: A bare string literal ("""...""") on its own line was silently accepted as a comment (4.7 parser explicitly exempted STRING literals)
rows.new: PR #121833 (merged 2026-08-18, milestone 4.8): string literals are subject to the STANDALONE_EXPRESSION warning; still accepted, suppressible per line/project; removal planned for Godot 5
rows.agent_rule: Never use a standalone string literal as a comment or docstring; use `#` comments and `##` doc comments.
